prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: The Quinn family mansion, living room. A spacious, luxurious present-day living room in a wealthy suburban mansion, in cream, white and gold. Back wall: three tall arched French windows with sheer white curtains and gold tie-backs, through which daylight floods in from behind and slightly above, the main light source. Left wall: a white marble fireplace with a large gilt-framed mirror above it and two tall vases of white orchids on the mantel. Right wall: a wide open double doorway with white panelled doors, the way in from the marble entrance hall, and a gold console table beside it. Front wall (behind the camera): built-in white bookshelves. A crystal chandelier hangs from the centre of the ceiling and adds warm fill light. A long cream tufted three-seat sofa stands in the middle of the room with its back to the windows on the back wall, facing the camera. A low rectangular glass-and-gold coffee table stands in front of the sofa. A single cream upholstered armchair stands across the coffee table from the sofa, nearer the camera, its back to the camera and facing the sofa. A pale-grey patterned rug lies under the sofa, the table and the armchair, on a polished light wood floor.
Revision notes: Keep the floor plan, front view, back view and left-side view exactly as in v4: they are right. Fix only the right-side view: it must face the RIGHT wall straight on: the open white double doorway onto the marble entrance hall in the centre of the frame, the gold console table beside it, the end of the window wall only as a sliver at the LEFT edge, the bookshelf wall only at the RIGHT edge, the sofa seen from its end on the left. The fireplace is behind the camera and must not appear.
Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
